name: dist_normal_pdf
description: Computes the probability density function (PDF) of the normal distribution. Returns the probability densityat point x for a normal distribution with specified parameters.

name: dist_normal_quantile
description: Computes the quantile function (inverse CDF) of the normal distribution. Returns the value x such that P(X ≤ x) = p, where p is the cumulative probability.

name: dist_pareto_log_cdf
description: Computes the natural logarithm of the cumulative distribution function (CDF) of the pareto distribution. Returns the logarithm of the probability that a random variable X is less than or equal to x.

name: dist_pareto_median
description: Returns the median (50th percentile) of the pareto distribution, which equals the mean.

name: dist_pareto_sample
description: Generates random samples from the pareto distribution with specified parameters.

name: dist_poisson_skewness
description: Returns the skewness of the poisson distribution.

name: dist_poisson_stddev
description: Returns the standard deviation (σ) of the poisson distribution.

name: dist_rayleigh_cdf
description: Computes the cumulative distribution function (CDF) of the rayleigh distribution. Returns the probability that a random variable X is less than or equal to x.

name: dist_rayleigh_kurtosis
description: Returns the kurtosis of the rayleigh distribution.

name: dist_students_t_cdf
description: Computes the cumulative distribution function (CDF) of the students_t distribution. Returns the probability that a random variable X is less than or equal to x.

name: dist_students_t_kurtosis_excess
description: Returns the excess kurtosis of the students_t distribution.

name: dist_uniform_int_variance
description: Returns the variance (σ²) of the uniform_int distribution.

name: dist_uniform_real_hazard
description: Computes the hazard function of the uniform_real distribution.

name: dist_uniform_real_log_cdf_complement
description: Computes the natural logarithm of the complementary cumulative distribution function (1 - CDF) of the uniform_real distribution. Returns the logarithm of the probability that X > x, equivalent to the survival function.

name: dist_uniform_real_quantile
description: Computes the quantile function (inverse CDF) of the uniform_real distribution. Returns the value x such that P(X ≤ x) = p, where p is the cumulative probability.

name: dist_uniform_real_range
description: Returns the range of the uniform_real distribution.

name: dist_uniform_real_support
description: Returns the support of the uniform_real distribution.

name: dist_weibull_hazard
description: Computes the hazard function of the weibull distribution.
